extension.description: Track your OpenCode Go 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage limits from the status bar.
view.container.title: OpenCode Go Usage
view.usage.name: Usage
command.showUsage.title: Show usage
command.refresh.title: Refresh usage
command.openConsole.title: Open console in browser
command.diagnostics.title: Show diagnostics
command.connectWorkspace.title: Connect workspace…
command.disconnectWorkspace.title: Disconnect workspace
config.title: OpenCode Go Usage
config.refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh. Values below 60 are rounded up to 60.
config.statusBar.enabled.description: Show usage in the status bar.
config.statusBar.meter.description: Which window the status bar shows.
config.statusBar.meter.auto: Whichever window is closest to its limit
config.baseUrl.description: Origin of the OpenCode workspace console. Only change this if you are pointing at a different deployment.
config.workspaceId.description: Workspace to read usage from (the `wrk_…` in your console URL). Set it together with the session cookie via the "OpenCode Go: Connect workspace" command; the cookie is kept in SecretStorage, not here.
config.language.description: Language for the panel, tooltips, and notifications. "auto" follows VS Code's display language and falls back to English.
